chunks.title: Air Traffic Control Altitude and Separation Tolerances
chunks.text: Air Traffic Control Altitude and Separation Requirements: Minimum radar separation is 3 nautical miles within terminal airspace, and 5 nautical miles en-route. Emergency descent target altitude is 10,000 feet MSL (Mean Sea Level) or lowest safe altitude.

chunks.title: Emergency Transponder Squawk Codes
chunks.text: Air Traffic Control Emergency Transponder Squawk Codes: Squawk 7500 indicates Unlawful Interference or Hijacking. Squawk 7600 indicates Lost Radio Communications or Radio Failure NORDO. Squawk 7700 indicates General Emergency Mayday declaration.

chunks.title: Reactor Core R-101 Pressure and Quench Thresholds
chunks.text: Chemical Plant Emergency Overpressure Safety Tolerances: Reactor Core R-101 Maximum Allowable Working Pressure MAWP is 450.0 PSI. Emergency venting trip threshold is 485.5 PSI. Quench tank injection rate is 1250 liters per minute of water glycol solution.

chunks.title: Adult CPR Compression Rate and Ratio
chunks.text: 911 Emergency Medical Dispatch CPR Protocol: For adult cardiac arrest, deliver 30 chest compressions followed by 2 rescue breaths. Maintain compression rate of 100 to 120 beats per minute, pressing at least 2 inches deep.

chunks.title: Tourniquet Placement and Hemorrhage Control
chunks.text: 911 Emergency Medical Dispatch Bleeding Protocol: For severe arterial extremity bleeding, apply windlass tourniquet 2 to 3 inches above the wound, never over a joint. Tighten until bleeding ceases completely.

chunks.title: Pediatric Seizure Management and Dispatch Priority
chunks.text: 911 Emergency Medical Dispatch Pediatric Seizure Protocol: Place child on their side in recovery position. Do not insert anything into mouth. If seizure exceeds 5 minutes, dispatch Advanced Life Support Priority 1 unit immediately.

chunks.title: Active Shooter Response and Perimeter Standoff
chunks.text: Police Department Tactical Operations Active Threat Protocol: Code 10-33 emergency traffic. First contact team of 2 to 4 officers must bypass wounded and neutralize threat immediately. Establish outer perimeter at 300 meters standoff.

chunks.title: Officer Distress Emergency Radio Ten-Codes
chunks.text: Police Department Radio Communications Emergency Ten-Codes: Code 10-33 signals emergency traffic only. Code 10-78 requests urgent backup. Code 10-99 indicates officer in extreme danger or officer down, triggering all-units Priority 1 response.

chunks.title: High-Rise Staging Floor and Standpipe Attack Pressure
chunks.text: Fire Department High-Rise Operations: Establish interior staging area 2 floors below the fire floor. Connect attack lines to standpipe on floor below fire, maintaining 100 PSI nozzle pressure with 2.5 inch supply lines.

chunks.section: Hazmat Operations: Boiling Liquid Expanding Vapor Explosion
chunks.title: Hazmat BLEVE Standoff and Evacuation Radius
chunks.text: Fire Department Hazardous Materials BLEVE Protocol: For pressurized liquefied gas vessels exposed to direct flame impingement with BLEVE risk, immediately withdraw all personnel and establish minimum 1 mile isolation perimeter in all directions.
